messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stocky four-legged creature with the furry body, head, and limbs of a brown bear combined with beetle features. The body is covered in dense shaggy brown fur and stands on four thick bear legs with clawed paws. The head is bear-like with a tan muzzle, dark nose, and small rounded ears. Glossy dark reddish-brown beetle elytra are set into the fur over the shoulders and sides, with large translucent tan membranous wings with brown veining extending outward from the shoulder area. Rows of dark oval slit-like openings are visible in the fur on the flank and hindquarter. A long segmented glossy dark insect-like tail with a forked tip extends from the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with tan muzzle, dark nose, and brown eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown furry bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale curved claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long segmented glossy dark reddish-brown insect-like tail with a forked pointed tip", "part": "tail", "where": "extending down from the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large translucent tan membranous wings with brown veins", "part": "wings", "where": "extending outward from the shoulder area on each side of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark reddish-brown domed beetle elytra", "part": "plates", "where": "clustered on the neck, shoulders and upper sides of the body"}, {"looks_like": "rows of dark oval slit-like openings in the fur", "part": "markings", "where": "on the mid-flank and on the upper hindquarter"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 2}
